result.topic_en: A dated heading note (December 1857) on the potential of three spheres, stating that by means of transformation by reciprocal radius vectors (inversion) the problem is reduced to the case where the centres lie on a straight line.
result.transcription:
Potential dreier Kugeln. December 1857.
Mittelst der Transformation durch reciproke Radiivectoren zurückgeführt auf den Fall, wo die Mittelpunkte in einer geraden Linie liegen.

methods.what: Inversion (transformation by reciprocal radius vectors) used to reduce the three-sphere potential problem to the case of collinear centres
